## Change

Describe the user-visible result and any compatibility or migration impact.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused checks passed; final relevant changes passed the full required checks.
- [ ] Generated files rebuilt from source and reproducible.
- [ ] Browser/install evidence recorded where relevant.
- [ ] Artwork provenance and exact-version receipts preserved.

## Recovery

Name the rollback commit/release and any affected resource/configuration backups.
